description.narrative: The Transport Sector Program Support Project will contribute to the overarching growth acceleration objective of Niger's Poverty Reduction Strategy Paper (PRSP) by improving the core road infrastructure which is the backbone of the country's access to world markets. It will also directly contribute to the high-level National Road Transport Strategy (NRTS) objectives of supporting Niger's economic development and developing access to basic social services for the poorest. These objectives are consistent with the West African Economic and Monetary Union (Union Economique et Monetaire Ouest Africaine) (UEMOA) regional economic program and the new economic partnership for Africa's development strategy. There are two components to the project. The first component is the periodic maintenance and spot rehabilitation of unpaved roads to improve access to markets and services in densely populated areas with high economic potential, and thus help achieve the first project development objective. The second component is the institutional support to the main transport sector players through provision of capacity building and assistance in management and execution of road maintenance; it will help to achieve the second project development objective through support to the implementation of Niger's transport sector program.

The project development objectives are to (i) improve the physical access of rural population to markets and services on selected unpaved sections of the national road network, and (ii) strengthen the institutional framework, management and implementation of roadmaintenance in Niger.
